To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the quality of the KGs is very heterogeneous and that the best KG for a given use case depends on the use case.

DBpedia, FreeBase, and YAGO are comparable in their coverage of entities, DBpedia and Wikidata are comparable in terms of their coverage of relations, DBpedia is the most comprehensive in terms of its coverage of entities, relations, and attributes, and Wikidata has the best coverage in terms of entities, relations and attributes that are linked to external sources, and DBpedia and Wikdata are most comprehensive in terms their coverage of relations and attributes.

DBpedia is the best KG for general knowledge, YAGO the best for knowledge of the real world, Wikidata the best for knowledge that can be edited by everyone and that is not too technical, and OpenCyc the best for technical knowledge.
